name: Sujala Trading & Holdings Ltd
about: Incorporated in 1981, Sujala Trading & Holdings Ltd is in the business of investing in shares & securities and lending[1]
keyPoints:
Business Overview:[1]
Company is in the business of Investment in Shares & Securities etc. and is registered as a Non Systematically Important Non Deposit Taking Non-Banking Financial Company. It offers banking services such as loans and credit facilities, private funding, trading in stocks and shares,loans and investments, etc.

cons: Stock is trading at 2.67 times its book value
Company has low interest coverage ratio.
The company has delivered a poor sales growth of -1.66% over past five years.
Company has a low return on equity of -0.42% over last 3 years.
Working capital days have increased from 94.0 days to 137 days
